verdict.rationale: GitHub documents its own CI/CD through GitHub Actions for running workflows (github-docs-38, github-docs-11), and the GitHub CLI brings Actions to the terminal (github-docs-75). Plan-included Actions minutes imply platform-hosted execution (github-comm-16), but nothing documents private or self-hosted runners, and one community comment treats org-level self-hosted runners as a missing feature (github-comm-20). missing for 10: documented self-hosted/private runner support, documented platform-hosted runner details, centralized visibility across runners, independent hands-on corroboration.
